title: fix(waterfall): enforce gp-only catch-up allocation
body:
## Summary

Three bug fixes for the institutional 8-and-20 carry waterfall:

### Bug 1 — GP catch-up threshold used wrong LP invested capital
`waterfall_runner.py` used `cumulative_invested_by_period[0]` (= 0.0 in a ramping stack) instead of LP's actual committed capital for the catch-up formula. Added explicit `lp_invested_capital_keur` field to `WaterfallRunnerInputs`.

### Bug 2 — PREF double-counted in aggregate waterfall
`PREFERRED_RETURN` was included in the aggregate cascade alongside `[ROC, GP_CATCH_UP, PROMOTE, RESIDUAL]`. But PREF is already computed per-investor in Step 1 and included in per-investor results. This caused aggregate `total_allocated` to exceed `available_cash`. Fixed by removing PREF from the aggregate cascade.

### Bug 3 — `PreferredReturnAllocation.entry_for()` / `total_allocated_keur` wrong
`entry_for(period)` returned the last period's result regardless of the requested period index. `total_allocated_keur` summed across all periods instead of returning the period-specific value.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `domain/sponsor/waterfall_runner.py` | Added `lp_invested_capital_keur` to `WaterfallRunnerInputs`; catch-up threshold uses explicit LP invested capital |
| `domain/sponsor/multi_investor_waterfall_runner.py` | Removed PREF from aggregate cascade; passes `lp_invested_capital_keur` to aggregate inputs |
| `domain/sponsor/preferred_return_allocation.py` | Fixed `entry_for()` period lookup; fixed `total_allocated_keur` |
| `tests/test_institutional_carry_waterfall.py` | Updated tests to match corrected behavior |

## Testing

- Full suite: **2973 tests passing**
